title: 第742章 屠刀成佛第741章 弹弓初成
lines: 离开沐王府时，天色尚早，晨雾未散。
陆沉没有走官道，出了府城便折向东南，驾驭青鹰朝灌江口的方向行去。
走了不到两百里，云层下的山脉忽然开阔起来。
两侧的稀疏的林木向后退去。
天地间像是突然没有了山脉的存在，也没有了前路，只有一片仿佛虚无的空地，阻断了他前进的方向。
空地上站着一个人。
那人身量极高，比常人高出整整一个头，肩背宽阔如山，双臂粗如树干。
一身灰白色的僧袍被肌肉撑得紧绷绷的，像是随时都要裂开。
他没有穿鞋，赤足踩在冰冷的泥地上，脚趾粗短如铁钉，深深嵌入泥土中。
他双手合十，眼帘低垂，头顶的戒疤在晨雾中若隐若现。
若不是他身上那股不加掩饰的宗师气息，陆沉几乎以为这是一尊被遗落在荒野中的石像。
青鹰不得已落地，陆沉也因此翻身下来，看着那人。
那人睁开了眼。
那双眼睛不大，有些细长，可那细长的缝隙中透出的光，不是佛门的慈悲，是屠户打量待宰牲畜时的冷漠。
“天赐侯，贫僧法号慧嗔。”
他的声音低沉浑厚，像从胸腔中挤出来的，每一个字都带着一股铁锈般的腥气。
“师祖让我来请侯爷去寺中一叙，侯爷莫让贫僧为难，随我走一趟吧。”
陆沉上下打量了他一眼，嘴角微微上扬，带着几分讥讽：“你这气息，也是和尚？杀戮如此重，佛门什么时候连屠户都收了？”
慧嗔没有动怒，甚至没有变色。
他将合十的双手缓缓放下，垂在身侧，那双手粗大如蒲扇，指节凸起，手背上青筋如虬龙盘踞。
他低头看着自己那双沾满血腥的手，语气平淡得像在念一段早就烂熟于心的经文：“放下屠刀，立地成佛。”
“贫僧杀了一辈子生，临老了放下刀，便有了佛性，佛祖不嫌贫僧，侯爷倒替佛祖操起心来了。”
陆沉嗤笑一声，那笑声在空旷的山野中格外刺耳：“你手上可不光是杀猪杀狗，人也没少杀！”
“你这样的人也能这么简单地成佛，那让那些早就已经虔诚礼拜，每日向善的人怎么办？他们善了一辈子，还比不上你们作恶了一辈子之后的念头一动？”
他的声音冷了下来：“这世上哪里来的这种道理？贼秃，说到底，也无非是你们的拳头更大一些罢了！”
慧嗔抬起头看着陆沉，那双细长的眼睛中依旧没有怒意，只有一种居高临下的俯视，像一尊俯瞰众生的佛像，在怜悯一个不知天高地厚的蝼蚁。
他开口，声音依旧平静：“贫僧自有佛性。”
“那些礼佛之人，整日磕头诵经，却不懂什么是真正的教化。”
“侯爷天赋异禀，若是肯拜入我禅宗佛门，日后必定能修成金身罗汉，成就不可限量！何必在红尘中打滚，与那些凡夫俗子为伍？”
陆沉看着他，像在看一件很有趣的事。
他摇了摇头，嗤笑一声：“让我去跟你们做那些见不得人的勾当，我可没有自甘堕落的打算。”
慧嗔的面色终于变了。
content_en:
When we left Prince Mu's Mansion, it was still early and the morning fog had not dispersed.
Lu Chen did not take the official road. After leaving the city, he turned southeast and rode the green eagle towards the mouth of the Guanjiang River.
After walking less than two hundred miles, the mountains under the clouds suddenly opened up.
The sparse trees on both sides receded.
There seemed to be no mountains in the world suddenly, and there was no way forward. There was only a void that seemed to be empty, blocking his direction.
There was a man standing in the clearing.
The man was extremely tall, a whole head taller than an ordinary person, with shoulders as broad as mountains and arms as thick as tree trunks.
The gray-white monk's robe was stretched tightly by muscles, as if it was about to burst at any time.
He had no shoes on and stepped barefoot on the cold mud. His toes were as short as iron nails and were deeply embedded in the soil.
He clasped his hands together, lowered his eyes, and the ring scar on his head was looming in the morning mist.
If it weren't for the undisguised aura of a master, Lu Chen would have almost thought it was a stone statue abandoned in the wilderness.
Qing Ying had no choice but to land, so Lu Chen turned over and looked at the man.
The man opened his eyes.
The eyes were small and somewhat slender, but the light coming from the slender slit was not the compassion of Buddhism, but the indifference of a butcher when he looked at the livestock to be slaughtered.
"God-given prince, the poor monk's dharma name is Hui Ai."
His voice was deep and deep, as if it was squeezed out of his chest, and every word carried a rusty smell.
"Master asked me to invite the Marquis to go to the temple to talk about it. Lord Marquis, please don't embarrass the poor monk and come with me."
Lu Chen looked him up and down, and raised the corners of his mouth slightly, with a hint of sarcasm: "Do you have the aura to be a monk? With so much killing, when did Buddhism even accept butchers?"
Hui Ai didn't get angry, or even change his color.
He slowly lowered his clasped hands and hung them by his side. The hands were as thick as cattail fans, with raised knuckles and veins on the backs of the hands like dragons.
He looked down at his bloody hands and spoke in a calm tone, as if he was reciting a scripture he had long known by heart: "Put down the butcher knife and become a Buddha immediately."
"The poor monk spent his whole life killing people. When he got old and put down his sword, he acquired Buddha nature. The Buddha did not mind the poor monk. The Marquis became worried about the Buddha."
Lu Chen sneered, and the laughter was particularly harsh in the empty mountain wilderness: "You not only kill pigs and dogs, but also people!"
"People like you can become a Buddha so easily, but what about those people who have already prayed devoutly and do good deeds every day? They have been good for a lifetime, but they are not as good as your thoughts after doing evil for a lifetime?"
His voice turned cold: "Where in the world does this kind of truth come from? Thief bald, after all, it's just that your fists are bigger!"
Hui Ai raised his head and looked at Lu Chen. There was still no anger in his slender eyes, only a condescending look down on him, like a Buddha statue overlooking all living beings, pitying an ant who didn't know the heights of the sky.
He spoke, his voice still calm: "The poor monk has his own Buddha nature."
"Those who worship Buddha spend all day kowtowing and chanting sutras, but they don't understand what true enlightenment is."
"Your Majesty is extremely talented. If you are willing to join my Zen Buddhism, you will definitely become a golden Arhat in the future. Your achievements will be immeasurable! Why should you wallow in the world of mortals and associate with ordinary people?"
Lu Chen looked at him as if he was watching something very interesting.
He shook his head and sneered: "Ask me to do those shameful things with you. I have no intention of sinking myself."
Hui'an's expression finally changed.
title_en: Chapter 742: The Butcher's Knife Becomes a Buddha Chapter 741: The Slingshot Begins to Become a Buddha
